overall_description: A family-size panini grill with a wide rectangular base, a thick insulated clamshell lid, and a latch tab at the front lip. The lid rotates open on a rear horizontal revolute hinge, the latch tab rotates downward on a small front hinge to release the lid, and a thermostat knob rotates continuously on a short side-face shaft. Medium kitchen counter scale.
